# AstryxMarkdown { #anylumino.AstryxMarkdown }

```python
AstryxMarkdown(text, **props)
```

Render Markdown content through Astryx.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|---------|--------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| text    | str    | Text content synchronized to the frontend component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | _required_ |
| **props | Any    | JSON-safe Markdown props. Useful keys: display, density, headingLevelStart, isStreaming, sources, citationStyle, contentWidth, contentAlign, autolink, data-testid, className, and style. Upstream plugin and link-click callback props are JavaScript functions and are not usable from Python props. anylumino manages the markdown text content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Markdown>. | `{}`       |
